newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Jan 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rift between Qatar and Bahrain widens. The two Gulf Arab states have been entangled in a war of words over a territorial dispute.
- Ministry of information shuts firms in the emirate of Sharjah for pirating computer software. The UAE has launched a campaign against copyright violations.
- Dubai dealer ready to settle debts. The consumer electronics dealer who had fled with almost 16 million dirhams in debts has returned to Dubai offering to settle with 89 creditors.
- Oman to pass new law to woo foreign capital.
- UAE Central Bank warns against deals with unlicensed firms.
- GCC chief on visits to Bahrain and Qatar to discuss the results of a Gulf Arab mediation meeting aimed at easing tensions between the two countries.
- Bahrain to hold a conference on intellectual property rights this month.
